A2_S1_D1: ^Narrator: You find Chione again the next morning, mixed in with the flow of Viridi who are busily milling about.
^Chione: Remember the storm that brought you to our island? It's caused a bit of damage to the creatures’ homes in the forest, so we're helping them clean up.
^Chione: We would've done so earlier, but yesterday was busy enough as it is by making sure no one was missing or injured.
^Narrator: The sight of the village bustling about is familiar — you understand more than anyone how important it is to look after the people, first.
^Noelle: The things about my boat supplies, and getting an audience with your Elder…
^Noelle: Those can wait until you're done with more important work.
^Noelle: …Is it alright if we lend a hand? You did give us food and shelter, so it's the least we can do.
^Noelle: I'll do most of the heavy lifting!
^Chione: Oh! If you're sure, we really could use the help.
^Chione: If you head east from here, you should be able to find Bri. She's one of the villagers in charge of cleanup efforts!
